name: Webform Node Analysis
description: Enables to obtain statistics on the results of form submissions.
project_description:
The Webform Analysis module provides statistical analysis and visualization for Webform submissions. It allows administrators to generate charts and tables to analyze form data and submission patterns.

 Features 
 
 Chart Types : Visual representations of form data using:
 
 Tables for data display 
 Pie Charts for categorical data 
 Column Charts for comparative data 
 
 
 Component Selection : Choose which form fields to include in analysis 
 Date Range Filtering : Filter submissions by date range 
 Draft Submission Analysis : Include or exclude draft submissions 
 Block Integration : Display analysis charts using the Webform Analysis block 
 Automatic Updates : Analysis updates as new submissions are received 
 
 
 See the README.md for installation, configuration and usage instructions .
